name: Estella-Lizarra (Spain)
description: White field charged at the centre with the crowned arms of the city of Estella (a star on red within a bordure of the chains of Navarre).
history: The flag of Estella is formed of a rectangular cloth of proportions 2/3, white, with the arms of the city in their tinctures at the centre.

features.role: Estella arms — star on red within a bordure of the chains of Navarre
star, chains and crown of the arms
